epoch_note: day 0. Records created before this instant are pre-history: kept as evidence, excluded from calibration unless --prehistory is passed.
notes: One file decides every id-bearing input: db path, encoders, recipes, decider order, policy identity. Change a value here and the record ids change with it, which is the point.

policy.note: One selection per session on the initial card using paired 3-axis decider review, then keep (pipeline/src/decide.ts).

encoders.note: Primary dense encoder on decent-spider :8081: llama-server --embedding (OpenAI-compatible /v1/embeddings), Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B Q8, 1024 dims, loopback 127.0.0.1:8081 (systemd user unit llama-embed.service).

default_encoder.note: Semantic default. consult scores with this encoder when its rows exist, otherwise falls back to any dense encoder that has rows (hash-ngram, which needs no infrastructure).
